# Code of conduct

This applies to every KN990x repository and to everything around it: issues, pull
requests, reviews and discussions.

## Expected

- Be respectful and assume good faith. People report bugs because they want the project to
  work.
- Keep the discussion about the work: the code, the behaviour, the design.
- Give context: versions, steps, what you expected and what happened.
- Accept that a single maintainer decides the scope of the project, and that "no" is a
  valid answer to a feature request.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language of any kind.
- Personal attacks, trolling, or deliberately derailing a thread.
- Publishing someone else's private information.
- Disclosing a vulnerability publicly before it has been fixed (see the
  [security policy](SECURITY.md)).

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or remove comments, lock threads, or block accounts that
break these rules. To report a problem privately, use the private vulnerability reporting
channel described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md) and say that it is a conduct
report.
